entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alfred Wilhelm Steinke was a German ice hockey player. Steinke played on the Germany men's national ice hockey team at the 1928 Winter Olympics. He became one of the oldest male hockey players to compete in the Olympics at the age of 48.
